name: Qatar National Cement Company (Q.P.S.C.)
summary: Qatar National Cement Company (Q.P.S.C.) manufactures and sells cement, lime, washed sand, and other related products in Qatar. The company offers ordinary Portland, sulphate resistant Portland, and white cements; hydrated and calcined lime products; and calcium carbonate and calcium carbonate fines, ground granulated blast furnace slag, and washed sand products. Qatar National Cement Company (Q.P.S.C.) was incorporated in 1965 and is headquartered in Doha, Qatar.
